conclusion.coverageStatement: This bounded audit found no additional reusable image specific to Jake's indoor Playbarn, Pirates Landing Camberley, or Grassy Hill Sandhurst. It does not prove such photos do not exist.

venueResults.name: Jake's Playbarn
venueResults.result: Specific names returned zero. Trilakes Sandhurst returned one licensed Commons aerial of Trilakes Country Park; not shown to depict the indoor Playbarn. Broad Flickr Trilakes first 20 results concern Adirondack/Saranac NY or personal portraits; no exact venue evidence. Rejected.

venueResults.name: Pirates Landing Camberley
venueResults.result: Camberley/Surrey-qualified queries returned zero. Broad Flickr Pirates Landing returned capped 240 hits; first 20 mostly Seattle Seafair/Alki, plus other subjects with no Camberley identity. No accepted branch-specific photo.

venueResults.name: Grassy Hill Sandhurst
venueResults.result: Sandhurst/Crowthorne-qualified queries returned zero. Berkshire returned four different geographic/subject results. Broad Flickr/England results are generic grassy hills or named hills elsewhere; no precise named-park evidence. Rejected.

conclusion.existingFiveQualityReview: Fresh Commons API matched all five deployed image captions/authors/licences/dimensions. Ambarrow is 4800×3200 reserve scene; Frimley 5472×3648 canal at park; California 1500×1000 entrance road; Memorial 640×480 precise St Peter Frimley garden; Morgan 448×336 exact locality caption but no coordinates. Landscape road/canal views are authentic venue-related subjects; quality ranking could favor characteristic park views automatically. Morgan should retain low-resolution indication. This is metadata/subject quality review, not visual inspection.
conclusion.sourceRestrictions: Only public API read requests. No authentication, credentials, paid provider APIs, engine edits, hardcoded assignments or photo byte copying. Official-site openGraph images without explicit licence were not accepted. Public Openverse licence_type=commercial is a reuse-permission filter, not a paid API mode.
